name: io.github.theYahia/yookassa-mcp
title: YooKassa
description: YooKassa - payments, refunds, 54-FZ receipts, payouts, SBP, recurring, webhooks (Russia)

environmentVariables.name: YOOKASSA_SHOP_ID
environmentVariables.description: Shop ID from the YooKassa cabinet (Settings -> Shop)

environmentVariables.name: YOOKASSA_PAYOUT_AGENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Payout agent ID, required only for the payout tools

environmentVariables.name: YOOKASSA_PAYOUT_SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Payout secret key, required only for the payout tools
